prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic fashion editorial in a working Victorian palm-house conservatory during hard summer rain. The subject is one unmistakably adult woman whose appearance is to follow the supplied reference image. Image 1 provides general visible appearance guidance only for this original adult subject. In an active work stance, she uses both hands to turn a large verdigris handwheel, visibly opening overhead ventilation louvers among cycads, wet copper pipes, rain-streaked glass, and mist.

Show her entire figure from crown to flat practical boots in a neutral eye-level catalog/editorial three-quarter view. Keep both hands, handwheel, complete hem, slit endpoint, and unobscured slit side inside the frame. Her tailored floor-length dress has a high-neck opaque long-sleeve fitted bodice joined to a continuous opaque waist-and-hip yoke, which stays closed and stable through the action. Exactly one finished thigh-high side slit begins below the yoke at upper thigh and continues to the hem, exposing one working leg. Two continuous skirt panels meet at the endpoint; their finished parallel stitched edges descend to the hem. The opposite skirt side stays closed, with both panels joined above the endpoint. Calm fabric weight makes the constructed opening readable. Diffuse storm daylight reveals the edge stitching. Present the complete garment and work action with even visual emphasis and photorealistic materials.
negative_en: low resolution, broken facial features, illustration look, distorted fingers, 3D render look, cartoon style, plastic-looking skin, unrealistic hands

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: This remains the immutable pre-pack interpretation governing the scene.
Fantasy armor would replace the assigned continuous dress topology.
Perceptual unease would distract from strict garment-structure evaluation.

decisions.rationale: The locked two-handed wheel action already determines a physically legible stance.
The run-local full-figure topology view needs direct structural clarity.
A wider power stance could distort or obscure the slit endpoint.
Rim lighting could reduce the visibility of finished dark fabric edges.
Golden-hour light conflicts with the established hard-rain conservatory event.
Generic window light adds less evidence than diffuse storm illumination.

preserved_evidence: one unmistakably adult woman whose appearance is to follow the supplied reference image
uses both hands to turn a large verdigris handwheel

authorial_decisions.decision: Use a high-neck opaque long-sleeve fitted bodice joined to a continuous opaque waist-and-hip yoke above one constructed thigh-high side slit.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Observable garment landmarks preserve coverage and slit topology while removing repeated anatomical wording.

authorial_decisions.decision: Show the entire figure, complete hem, slit endpoint, and handwheel in one unobscured three-quarter frame.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Every unchanged gate must remain independently inspectable in one image.

authorial_decisions.decision: Use a neutral eye-level catalog/editorial camera with even emphasis across garment and work action.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Neutral presentation avoids localized emphasis while retaining structural visibility.
